description: Enables applications to securely connect with users' bank accounts for financial data access, verification, and payments.
auth_notes: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a client_id and secret, sent either in the request body or via PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET headers.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up on the Plaid Dashboard for free to get a live or sandbox client_id and secret, with sandbox access free and pay-as-you-go production access.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST/JSON API covering auth, balance, transactions, investments, liabilities, identity, transfers, income, and verification endpoints.
mcp_notes: Plaid officially publishes an MCP server via its ai-coding-toolkit repository to serve docs and assist IDE/AI coding agents.
rationale: Plaid provides a fully documented public REST API, self-serve free sandbox/dashboard credentials, and an official MCP server, making it fully ready for agent toolkits.

evidence.note: Details that Plaid API requests require client_id and secret in headers or body.
Shows pay-as-you-go / free tier setup and free sandbox access.
Outlines REST API architecture, endpoints, OpenAPI definition, and client libraries.
Official Plaid repository providing the Plaid MCP server for AI tooling.
